fields.statement: At 76a7035 (fix for review quality f1), in a detached checkout: go test ./internal/api -run 'TestRexCellBounds|TestRexInstall' -count=1 -v passes all 10 tests. TestRexInstallSizesEachAppLayerToItsCells registers zz-sized with Cols 77 Rows 21, runs rex.install, and finds its action's bounds = cell_bounds(ctx.block_id, 77, 21) and command { BIN, "tui", "app", "zz-sized" } with no "launch"; an app with no size gets the 100x30 default. The new TestRexCellBoundsScalesTheBlockToItsWindow ran under /opt/homebrew/bin/luajit (not skipped): cell_bounds' bounds match surface.BoundsForCells for a whole-window block, a half-width split and a 70/30 split, so from a split pane the layer is now sized from the window, not the block. The Lua reads session.view as windows[].layers[].layout{rect,block_id,split{before,after}} and kind "tiled", which matches rexuikit v0.2.0 client.LayoutNode/ViewSplit/LayerTiled, and the scale-up matches its windowCellsFrom (round(cols/rect[3])). go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/rex-install passes (default app bounds cell_bounds(ctx.block_id, 100, 30), each app runs tui app <name>). make fmt-check vet test exits 0; make self-check fails only on stale .rhiza/rendered files from the run's model writes, nothing in code. As before, the Cols/Rows sizing is shown by the Go rex.install test, not by the txtar (review compliance f2, minor).
